_note: Display settings only. Brands, filters and prices come from the watch files. brand_order lists brand slugs to show first; featured_brands are shown before the rest (default: the featured tier in config.json); hidden_brands are never shown. planned_filters shows an option dimmed before any watch has it, for example {"water": ["200-plus"]}. brand_names overrides the name made from a new brand's slug. intent_cards: the four discovery cards. A card is shown only when approved is true, it has a filter ({group, value}) and at least one watch matches; the owner approves the label and the filter together. budget_captions: an optional editorial line per price band (otherwise the watch count is shown).

intent_cards.title: A watch for work
intent_cards.text: Clean, understated and easy to wear.
